title: Searching
summary: Eyes follow a small magnifier in the lower corner. Keep its circle away from both eyes.

poses.label: Look left
poses.direction: C eyes glance gently left, closed flat mouth. Small thin cyan magnifying glass at lower-right with generous empty space between its circle and the right eye.

poses.label: Sweep
poses.direction: Eyes glance gently right. Magnifying glass moves only a small distance right within the lower-right corner, never near the eyes. Keep same scale and handle angle.

poses.label: Find
poses.direction: Eyes become evenly attentive, mouth is a tiny closed smile. Magnifying glass settles at the midpoint of its short track, below eye height and clear of mouth.

cycle: Look left → sweep → find; use a short search sweep, then settle or continue with irregular holds.
